2. The respondent Nos. 1 to 10 herein filed the above mentioned writ petition challenging the proceeding of Miscellaneous Case No. 147 of 2004-2005 and the order dated 22.03.2005 passed therein for taking over the lease-hold land of the writ petitioners under the khas khatian of the Government (the annexure-G). 

 4. That the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Companygonj, Sylhet in violation of the above mentioned memo dated 17.10.1985 initiated Miscellaneous Case No.147 of 2004-2005 under section 92(2) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for taking over 1.54 acres of land out of that 20 acres of land under khas khatian No.1 of the Government and in that miscellaneous case by the impugned order dated 22.03.2005 the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Companygonj, Sylhet treated the aforesaid 1.54 acres of land as khas land of the Government with a direction to the concerned officials to take over possession of the same.
